description: Claim Jump: Rich Strike: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: A rich strike in {system}, held by an armed crew. {client} wants it taken.
Claim jump. Three miners, four guards. Clear the seam.
Armed holders on the claim. Be quick, they will call for help.
success: The seam is clear. {client} pays and moves in.
failure: You fail to clear the claim. {client} is displeased.
radio-claim: Claim ahead. Three miners, four guards.
Holders. One gunship among the guards.
Targets in view. Mind the gunship.
radio-owners: More on the tail. Hit the miners and leave.
